UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Information about the registered tarot reader or visitor.

TarotReading.title: Tarot Reading Record
TarotReading.description: A saved tarot reading session with spread cards, interpretations, and audio notes.

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this reading.

spreadType.description: Type of spread e.g. daily, three_card, celtic_cross, custom.

audioBase64.description: Synthesized audio voice reading data URI or wav string.

photoUrl.description: Optional snapshot of the physical cards.

notes.description: Seeker personal reflections and journal notes.

cards.description: JSON string of cards pulled with positions and orientations.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the reading was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the reading was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: User profile documents keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/readings/{readingId}.description: Archive of tarot readings for a specific user.
